scripts.features:
Discord Server: https://discord.com/invite/XKxQwBd2zT

Main Tab
[+] Auto Tap: This feature has been added and gives you the last world's taps without any prerequisites.
[+] Auto Rebirth: This feature has been added and is fully bypassed, so you don't need any upgrades to use it.
[+] Auto Rebirth Delay ~ Slider: A new slider has been added to control the delay for auto rebirth.

Pets Tab
[+] Auto Hatch Eggs: This feature has been added, allowing you to hatch eggs from anywhere without needing to be near them.
[+] Auto Disable Egg Animation: This feature has been added, but please be aware that it is currently unstable.
[+] Auto Sell Selected Pets: This feature allows you to automatically sell specific pets.
[+] Auto Sell via Types: This feature enables automatic selling based on pet types.
[+] Auto Sell via Variants: This feature enables automatic selling based on pet variants.

Upgrades Tab
[+] Auto Buy Upgrades: This feature has been added to automatically buy upgrades.
[+] Auto Select Machine: This feature allows you to select a specific machine to buy upgrades from (e.g., 1 for the first machine, 2 for the second, etc.).
[+] Auto Buy Upgrades Delay ~ Slider: A new slider has been added to control the delay for buying upgrades.

Misc Tab
[+] Anti-AFK: This feature has been added and should work as intended.
[+] Auto-Rejoin: This feature will automatically rejoin the game if you get disconnected or if an error message appears.
[+] Walkspeed Slider: A slider has been added to control your walkspeed.
[+] Infinity Jumps: This feature enables unlimited jumps.
[+] NoClip: This feature allows you to pass through objects.
